mapper.select: SELECT app_key AS appKey, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status >= 200 AND status < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCalls, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS tokens, COALESCE(AVG(latency_ms), 0) AS avgLatencyMs, MAX(create_time) AS lastAt FROM sys_ai_service_access_log WHERE create_time >= #{since} AND app_key IS NOT NULL AND app_key <> '' GROUP BY app_key ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT #{limit}
